interactions.note: The epitope of the H57 anti-TCR Fab on the TCR beta chain was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The crystal contains two complexes within a single asymmetric unit: complex A with TCR α-chain (chain A), β-chain (chain B), H57 Fab heavy chain (F), light chain (E); and complex B with TCR α-chain (chain C), β-chain (chain D), H57 Fab heavy chain (H), light chain (G). Each Fab molecule binds to the β-chain of N15 TCR using nearly the same interacting residues in a given pair, but with significantly different overall orientation. This finding implies that the same immune receptor may dock somewhat variably to a single ligand and that slight differences in the binding interaction can result in rather large rotations at the distal C region of the Fab "lever arm".; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.8 angstroms
